title: ASI Audit Decision
description: Schema for audit decisions written by ASI batch or cross-batch audit workflows.

decisionId.description: Stable ID for this audit decision. Suggested form: audit:<batch-slug>:<decision-kind>:<normalizedKey>.

scope.description: Scope in which the decision applies.

oneOf.description: Decision applies within one ASI batch.
Decision compares or reconciles items across multiple ASI batches.
Decision applies to one canonical document or its extracted items as a group.
Decision applies to one or more specific extracted items.

decision.description: Audit decision for the target extracted item or item set. Audit decisions do not mutate extracted items; later stages derive state from these records.

oneOf.description: Accepted for index-card generation in the appropriate form.
Accepted as an alias or search synonym, not as a source-defined term unless separately supported.
Accepted as an X-is-not-Y or authority-boundary index item.
Accepted as a relation between documents, terms, concepts, or authority areas.
Rejected because it is too generic, incidental, unsupported, or not useful for ASI routing.
Rejected because another extracted item or card already covers the same intended meaning.
Same literal key or nearby concept must be split into separate context-specific meanings.
Item should be merged with an existing item or card rather than indexed separately.
Item identifies possible source ambiguity or missing source wording that may need supervisor review.
Item should be reviewed by TerminologyInferrer for possible source term, alias, boundary phrase, relation name, or source heading.
Auditor cannot safely decide; supervisor or user decision is required before downstream use.
Decision intentionally postponed without accepting or rejecting the item.

literalKey.description: Optional literal term/key when the decision concerns same-spelling or same-key items.

normalizedKey.description: Optional normalized key used for matching.

indexerInstruction.description: Instruction to the indexer, such as create term literal plus term context cards.

sourcePatchRecommendation.description: Whether this audit decision suggests later source-patch consideration. This is not patch approval.

oneOf.description: No source-patch recommendation.
May be worth considering as a source clarification, but no approval is implied.
Source-patch relevance requires supervisor or user decision.
Patch approval is recorded in another supervisor/source-patch decision, not in this audit record.
Strongly supported by source or accepted workflow evidence.
Reasonably supported but may need later review or cross-document confirmation.
Weak or tentative support; use cautiously.
Requires audit, supervisor review, or stronger source evidence before relying on it.
Generated by a workflow and not yet reviewed.
Reviewed, but not necessarily accepted as final or authoritative routing metadata.
Accepted for its intended ASI workflow purpose.
Rejected for its intended ASI workflow purpose.
Replaced by a newer or better record.
Requires supervisor or user decision before downstream use.
